//Auth: How people sign in is chosen once, in the first-run wizard the Web app shows, and shared with this
host through the setup file. Set Auth:Mode here to skip the wizard on this machine:
LocalAccounts    - accounts held by this app (register + password sign-in)
EntraId          - Microsoft Entra ID (also needs AzureAd:TenantId and AzureAd:ClientId)
DemoPersonas     - no sign-in; the switchable demo persona. Refused in Production.
DevAuth:Enabled=true is the older way of saying DemoPersonas and still works.
